items.title: Natty Dominique Interview, 1967-11-15
items.q: He said, Greg, what'd you know?

ctx.x: Mr. Dominant, really, it seems like you're about to last at the Ohegan's, aren't you? Huh? You're about to last at the Ohegan's, aren't you? Yeah. Me and Louie and I? Yeah. I found on TV the other night. Yeah. He's failing, kid. Yeah, he is.

You know, he called up to it. One time, when he came in, he was at the airport, he called up, he called me. He said, Greg, what'd you know? I said, who's this? He said, it's Louie. We know, Cush. I said, you know what I know? You better give up that horn. I ain't give up that horn, I'm tired of it, man. That's his words, you know. I said, go and die, kill yourself.
I said, Louie, you're not to Louie. You're not young anymore. And that's true. When you get old, Johnny, listen. You cannot. Do the same thing, can you? No, you cannot.
